Recently I upgraded drools from version 6.0.0 Final to version 6.2.0 Final, I found some bpm process can't be deployed, the error message is as below. {color:#d04437}java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Errors while parsing knowledge base + errors added Unable to generate action invoker. - For Git Bash, this can be fixed by adding the following line to ~/.bashrc: export TERM=cygwin -or- export TERM=msys The first seems to be the original by git for windows, the second a popular known form to "heal" as well.
